title: Canonical principal thickening section lift
statement: For a commutative ring R, g in R, an open W of Spec R, a subsingleton H^1(W,O_W), a natural c, and the scalar power annihilation hypothesis, every section on the (n+c)-th principal thickening is the restriction of an ambient section at level n, where restriction is the canonical composite of consecutive transitions.

proof.text: Construct the composite thickeningGap of consecutive transition morphisms. Induction proves that it commutes with the ambient thickening maps and that its appTop is principalThickeningCanonical. Obtain the boundary family and its exactness/naturality from principal_thickening_obstruction.

Obtain d from principal_thickening_ideal_factor and compose it with factorThruImage of multiplication by g^(n+1) to get kappa. image.fac and the factorization equation identify its composite with the lower ideal inclusion with the higher inclusion. Naturality identifies the boundary of the restricted section with H.map kappa applied to its higher boundary.

Use Modules.H.map_comp_apply. The factor through H^1(W,O_W) is zero by the given Subsingleton hypothesis, and the remaining additive map preserves zero. Exactness of the boundary yields an ambient section; thickeningGap_appTop identifies the restriction with the required canonical composite.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0H3D and 0H3E: the same bounded-torsion factorization, expressed through image ideals and natural section boundaries rather than two-term complexes.

theorem principal_thickening_single_lift
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hH : Subsingleton (Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
      (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) 1))
    (c : ℕ)
    (hkill : ∀ (j : ℕ) (s : R), g ^ j * s = 0 → g ^ c * s = 0) :
    ∀ n (t : Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W (n + c), ⊤)),
      ∃ a : Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤),
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n).appTop a =
          principalThickeningCanonical R g W n c t
